direction values: false_pass | false_fail | flaky | spec_ambiguity | isolation/reward_hack | other. PM 'Ambiguity' items are tagged spec_ambiguity (they cause false fails for honest solvers).
Mechanism text for PM records is PM's finding title; for imported issues it is the first sentences of the issue body; Tokenless/Northset/GitHub-curated ones were written from the sources.
Statuses for PM records describe PM's own port; upstream status comes from upstream_refs / Northset replays.
